Today's dinner conversation could focus on how to keep your money safe when big changes happen in the markets. If something like Bitcoin dropping by 50% happens suddenly, it’s smart to have different types of savings and investments, like gold or regular bank accounts.

It might be worth checking today if you have a mix of savings that can handle ups and downs in the market. A simple thing you could try with your kids is looking at how much money you keep aside just for emergencies. See if it feels right to add some savings bonds or other safe investments.

You and your child could also test this week by setting up a small piggy bank where you save different types of coins together. It’s a fun way to learn about saving with different types of money!

Wishing you all peace and warmth today.

Warmly,
[Your Name]
